description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Line', which is a PHP class for rendering line plots in the Image_Graph PEAR package. It includes methods for drawing the line plot, handling fill styles, and rendering legend samples.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Line
classes.description: A class for rendering line plots within the Image_Graph PEAR package.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Returns the fill style of the plot element, specifically transparent fill.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample line in the legend to represent the plot.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the drawing of the line plot, handling stacking, points, and rendering on the canvas.
